login.headline: Your binder, open to the community.
login.lede: Keep track of the cards you own, list what you'd sell or trade, and message the collectors who have the card you're chasing.
login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: One account for your collection, wishlist and messages.
login.legal: By continuing you agree to the <terms>Terms</terms> and <privacy>Privacy Policy</privacy>.
login.no_payments: CardSwap does not process payments. You arrange deals directly with other collectors.
login.error: Couldn't sign you in. Please try again.
login.google_disabled: Google sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
login.google_disabled_dev: Google is not enabled on the local Supabase. Add an OAuth client to supabase/.env, set [auth.external.google] enabled = true and restart supabase — see docs/deployment.md. Use the dev sign-in form below meanwhile.

callback.failed: This sign-in link is invalid or has expired.

onboarding.title: Create your collector profile
onboarding.lede: Others will see your username and approximate city — never an address.
onboarding.username_hint: 3–20 characters: lowercase letters, numbers or underscores.
onboarding.terms: I agree to CardSwap's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
onboarding.terms_required: You need to agree to continue.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.bio_placeholder: What do you collect? Favourite sets, current chase cards…

settings.title: Settings
settings.danger_body: Permanently deletes your profile, collection, listings and photos. Messages you sent will show as “Deleted collector”.
